interface.name: serenity_window_manager
interface.description: Global factory for per-toplevel chrome handles.

request.name: get_toplevel

description.summary: create a chrome handle for an xdg_toplevel

request.description: Create a serenity_toplevel object for the given xdg_toplevel so the compositor can drive the window's chrome (currently the menu bar).

interface.name: serenity_toplevel
interface.description: Compositor-driven chrome for a single toplevel.

event.name: menubar_visibility

description.summary: show or hide the window's menu bar

event.description: Ask the client to show (visible != 0) or hide (visible == 0) the window's menu bar. The client keeps the bar's own presence: it is only drawn when the window actually has menus.
